statement: Rolling-restart run4 load-lane pressure has a deterministic live admin emission reproducer: a load-lane WebSocket query with fresh serve-ineligible readiness carrying PRIORITY_CONTROL_PLANE_RECOVERY_PENDING emits the retryable admin load-lane admission shape before SQL execution, without readiness-owner or load-generator patches.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not use a statistical or Docker rolling-restart gate for closure; prove the live admin emission mechanism with focused in-process WebSocket/API coverage.
Do not patch readiness-owner generation, load-generator wait-reason mapping, validation-matrix semantics, operation workflow, or historical test-output artifacts to make this Quest pass.

The proof may show the admin WebSocket load-lane emission path preserves PRIORITY_CONTROL_PLANE_RECOVERY_PENDING, but it must not claim that a retained rolling-restart node actually generated the exact readiness snapshot without separate live-sample evidence.

doneWhenSealed.closure: A deterministic live-admin test proves the WebSocket load lane itself emits the retained priority-recovery admission-pressure shape from the real readiness owner: when ControlPlaneReadinessService observes priority recovery as active and serveEligible=false, a load-lane query is rejected before SQL execution with deferRetry=true, bounded retryAfterMs, loadLaneAdmission details, and an error message carrying PRIORITY_CONTROL_PLANE_RECOVERY_PENDING; no readiness-owner, load-generator, validation-matrix, historical artifact, or stat-gate patch is used.
